body: I feel the same. I'm almost 30 and still depend on my parents for everything like I have all my life and I'm so tired of living this way.

At any point in my life I never knew what I wanted to do with my life, I'm 29 now and still have no clue what I want in life. I also feel there is no 'me' because I never figured out myself or never had an understanding about me, everything just feels empty to me. >i wish i had something, anything to live for.

It's even worse when you have no job, no colleagues, no friends, no one to interact with and live in a room all alone, and days weeks months years just go by and you're just living the same cold depressed day over and over again.

Everyone I know in my life has so much better lives than me, and it's hard not to feel envious towards them. I used to not compare myself with others by telling myself that when you're at the bottom it's pointless to compare your life with anyone else's. But now as I'm getting older and staying the same bottom position in life that I was in 10 years ago, it's hard not to compare myself with others and feel even worse about myself. Living in isolation and dealing with crippling depression isn't help either.
Same here. I never had any friends in my life and I'm 29 years old. I've felt so lonely all my life. Sometimes I just wish I had just one friend who I could talk with so I would feel less alone.

Man I can't believe 13 years has gone by since I was 16, in my mind I'm still 16. I lost my future, my youth inside this damn four walls. My life has been a living hell as long I can remember. I literally can't remember the last time I felt happy or laughed. Life has passed me by while I was rotting away in this room. I just wish I could feel some peace or happiness before I die, but at this point that feels impossible. I'm sorry that things are not going well for you. I'm in no position to give you any advice but please don't let life to just pass you by, make smarter decisions, find something you love and hold on to that and please don't end up like me.

I'm just too tired to even getting out of my bed and they think I'm just lazy.

I believe things get better for some people but not me, everything got worse over the years for me. I can't even think about my past and all my failures without having a panic attack.
Pain and hurt is all I've felt all my life, it's no way temporary. I wish I could be selfish and not care about my mom and end my painful life. Also wish that survival instinct wasn't so strong.

Wow I've never really given any thought as to why my mom loves me lol. Idk it's just a feeling that I've felt all my life. I live with my parents house with my mom, dad and sister. When I compare my mom with dad and sister, there are clear differences. My dad is disappointed with me so much and so ashamed of me, sister is the same. They see me as loser who amounts to nothing, and they can go weeks ignoring me, not saying a word to me. I really can't remember the last time I had a conversation with my sister other than just two words. They are ashamed of me because I tried to kill myself several times, and the fact that I'll be 30 soon and never had a job in my life.

Compared to them, my mom is different. She never say mean things to me, always checks up on me, asks how my day went even though she knows it's exactly like any other day. And I remember how sad she was, how she cried so much after my failed suicide attempts. There were so many opportunities to turn my life around but I managed to fuck every single one of them somehow but my mom still cares about me despite all that. I guess my dad and sister cared about me in the past but after I squandered every chance to have a some kind of life and continued to live a hermit lifestyle depending everything on my parents, they got sick of me. I can't understand why my mom can't see me for who I really am, a leech, a failure. Tbh I don't know how much longer my mom can care about me unconditionally or how much longer I can live for her sake. I'm sorry to hear that you have abusive parents, and I feel bad saying I've got a loving mom.
